rinTypes.name: Pitri Rin (Ancestral Debt)
rinTypes.cause: Neglect or disrespect towards ancestral lineage or elders in past generations.
rinTypes.chartCondition: Jupiter sits in House 2, 5, 9 or 12 afflicted by Venus, Mercury or Saturn, or Venus/Mercury sitting in Jupiter's pakka ghar.
rinTypes.safeRemedy: Feed golden whole wheat and yellow chana dal to cows; plant a peepal or banyan sapling and care for it.

rinTypes.name: Matri Rin (Mother's Debt)
rinTypes.cause: Disrespect towards mother, grandmother, or flowing natural water sources in family lineage.
rinTypes.chartCondition: Ketu in 4th house, or Moon afflicted by Rahu/Ketu in House 2 or 4.
rinTypes.safeRemedy: Offer unboiled pure milk to a clean flowing river or feed white rice and milk to silver bowls for elders.

rinTypes.name: Stri Rin (Wife / Feminine Debt)
rinTypes.cause: Injustice towards female members or lack of respect for family dignity in the past.
rinTypes.chartCondition: Venus afflicted by Sun, Moon or Rahu in 7th or 2nd house.
rinTypes.safeRemedy: Honor and offer clean white silk garments or camphor in holy places; respect female family members.

rinTypes.name: Swayam Rin (Self Karmic Debt)
rinTypes.cause: Self-centered actions or broken sacred vows made by the individual.
rinTypes.chartCondition: Sun sitting in 5th or 10th house afflicted by Saturn or Rahu.
rinTypes.safeRemedy: Perform Surya Namaskar daily facing sunrise; offer water in copper vessel to rising Sun.

rinTypes.name: Kudrati Rin (Nature's Debt)
rinTypes.cause: Harm caused to harmless creatures, pets or chopping fruitful trees.
rinTypes.chartCondition: Moon and Mars sitting together in 6th or 12th house.
rinTypes.safeRemedy: Provide daily water and grains to stray birds and dogs; never disturb wildlife.
